INSERT INTO email_sign_in_codes (user_id, code_hash, expires_at)
             VALUES ($1, $2, NOW() + make_interval(mins => $3))
             ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
                SET code_hash = EXCLUDED.code_hash,
                    attempts = 0,
                    created_at = NOW(),
                    expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at,
                    used_at = NULL
